# nb-studio user

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs from the API document. Do not edit: change the route’s describeRoute() or x-cli, then run `node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

## user create

Create a user

Requires both the `create` and the `assign-role` actions. A role scope marked `requiredOnCreate` must be given in `roleScopes`.

```bash
nb-studio user create --name <string> --email <string> --password <string>
```

| Flag            | Type   | Description |
| --------------- | ------ | ----------- |
| `--name`        | string | (required)  |
| `--username`    | string |             |
| `--email`       | string | (required)  |
| `--password`    | string | (required)  |
| `--role-scopes` | json   |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/users` (`usersCreateUser`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio user create --name Ann --email ann@example.com --password <password>
```

## user delete

Delete a user

Requires `confirm=true`.

```bash
nb-studio user delete <user> --confirm <string>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `user`   |             |

| Flag        | Type   | Description                                      |
| ----------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `--confirm` | string | `true`, to confirm deleting the user. (required) |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `DELETE /api/users/{userId}` (`usersDeleteUser`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio user delete u-12 --confirm true
```

## user disable

Disable a user

A disabled user can no longer sign in.

```bash
nb-studio user disable <user>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `user`   |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                                                  |
| ------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Disable this user? They are signed out everywhere.” |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/users/{userId}/disable` (`usersDisableUser`)

## user invitation create

Invite people by email

Requires the `invite` action, and `assign-role` as well when `roleScopes` is given. An address that already has an account gets nothing and is reported as `existingUser`.

```bash
nb-studio user invitation create --emails <string[]>
```

| Flag            | Type     | Description            |
| --------------- | -------- | ---------------------- |
| `--emails`      | string[] | (required; repeatable) |
| `--role-scopes` | json     |                        |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/users/invitations` (`usersInviteUsers`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio user invitation create --emails ann@example.com
```

## user invitation delete

Revoke an invitation

```bash
nb-studio user invitation delete <invitation>
```

| Argument     | Description |
| ------------ | ----------- |
| `invitation` |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                                               |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Revoke this invitation? Its link stops working.” |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `DELETE /api/users/invitations/{invitationId}` (`usersRevokeInvitation`)

## user invitation list

List pending and expired invitations

Accepted and revoked invitations drop out, so the list is bounded and not paged.

```bash
nb-studio user invitation list
```

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `email`, `status`, `invitedBy.name`, `expiresAt`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/users/invitations` (`usersListInvitations`)

## user list

List users

`q` searches name, username and email. `roleScope` and `role` filter by an assigned role and must be given together.

```bash
nb-studio user list
```

| Flag           | Type       | Description |
| -------------- | ---------- | ----------- |
| `--page`       | integer    |             |
| `--limit`      | integer    |             |
| `--q`          | string     |             |
| `--status`     | enabled \\ | disabled    |     |
| `--role-scope` | string     |             |
| `--role`       | string     |             |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `name`, `email`, `disabledAt`, `createdAt`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/users` (`usersListUsers`)

## user preference update

Set several of my preferences

Stores each given key in one transaction and answers every preference.

```bash
nb-studio user preference update --file <file.json>
```

| Flag     | Type | Description                                                       |
| -------- | ---- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--file` | path | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `PATCH /api/users/me/preferences` (`usersUpdateMyPreferences`)

## user role-scope set

Replace a user's roles in one role scope

A `single` scope takes one role; a `multiple` scope takes a list without duplicates, which may be empty for an optional scope.

```bash
nb-studio user role-scope set <user> <scope> --value <json>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `user`   |             |
| `scope`  |             |

| Flag      | Type | Description |
| --------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `--value` | json | (required)  |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `PUT /api/users/{userId}/roleScopes/{scope}` (`usersReplaceUserRoleScope`)

## user update

Update a user

Changes name, username or email. `username: null` removes the username.

```bash
nb-studio user update <user>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `user`   |             |

| Flag         | Type   | Description |
| ------------ | ------ | ----------- |
| `--name`     | string |             |
| `--username` | string |             |
| `--email`    | string |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `PATCH /api/users/{userId}` (`usersUpdateUser`)
